correctness.rationale: Model Theorem 3.1 gives the block with positive injective D. The unitary index reversal gives W_D. At e_{-2}v the five moments are 1,a,b,b,b with a=||Dv||^2>b=||D^2v||^2>0 for some v if D != I. The 3x3 determinant is exactly -b(a-b)^2<0, inconsistent with positivity of a subnormal moment matrix. On the shift-plus-normal branch normal extensions exist; self-commutator projection iff the nontrivial coupled block disappears.

value.rationale: An exact description of which of a recently represented broad hyponormal class are actually subnormal is an intrinsically motivated structural classification. It holds without finite-rank restrictions and supplies a uniform low-order determinant witness against every genuinely coupled member; useful to distinguish the weaker hyponormal property from the stronger normal-extension property.
